caveats: Live command working directory is weekly-brief/2026-11-06. Configure AZD_AGENT_PROJECT_ENDPOINT and AZD_AGENT_NAME in demos/azd-agent/.env and sign in to Azure CLI with Foundry access.
The completed Inspector capture took 396.8 seconds. Use this recorded image for the show; do not present its latency as typical.

Corporate-network PyPI TLS downloads failed. Local restoration used the approved package proxy, but the remote build needed the original public PyPI lockfile. Both failed and successful deployments are preserved.
The hosted agent requires its direct agent endpoint, not project-level agent_reference invocation. run.py uses the correct route and fails rather than replaying data.
Resources and model calls incur Azure charges. The new tagged resource group and hosted agent remain running for the show.
Registry and RBAC-warning changes are verified from GA release notes, not deliberately exercised against extra infrastructure.
The sample service key was aligned with its generated agent name, and requiredVersions were raised to GA minimums.
No evaluation suite, CI/CD pipeline, or resilience test is included in this bounded demo.
typical_seconds is a show-planning estimate from two successful remote calls, not a service latency guarantee.
